npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: A blackened strongbox half buried by the well, its lock melted shut and cracked.
npcs.found: the farmer's savings, and a healing draught he never got to drink.

npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: A tarred sea chest jammed among the stones under the broken bridge end, where the flood left it.
npcs.found: a merchant's purse and a good hide, still dry.

npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: A hunter's footlocker pushed under the lean-to, strapped with rawhide.
npcs.found: arrows, dried meat and a few coins.

npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: An offering box behind the shrine, its lid carved with a lantern.
npcs.found: coins left by a hundred pilgrims. The shrine would want them spent well.

npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: A soldier's kit chest beneath a fallen banner, the crows' leavings all over it.
npcs.found: an old campaign purse and a soldier's healing draught.

npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: A goblin hoard heaped in the tower's shell: a split crate stuffed with whatever they stole.
npcs.found: stolen coins, a goblin tooth necklace and a dented helm.

npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: A small iron-bound casket in the middle of the circle, cold to the touch.
npcs.found: a handful of old coins and a cold ember that will not go out.

npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: A rotting chest by the old Moonfell well, the lid clawed open and closed again.
npcs.found: silver the villagers never came back for.

npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: A quarryman's lockbox wedged behind a boulder. Bors would swear it isn't his.
npcs.found: wages somebody hid from somebody, and a block of good cheese.

npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: A goblin's stash chest, wedged behind the stones at the end of the drift, half full of the quarry's tools.
npcs.found: silver the goblins took off a carter, and a good leather jerkin.

npcs.name: Fishing Spot
npcs.note: The end of the old pier, where the lake drops away into deep water. Mind the fins.

npcs.name: Fishing Spot
npcs.note: Tobb's end of the pier. He doesn't mind company, as long as it keeps quiet.

npcs.name: Hearth
npcs.note: The Bent Nail's hearth crackles under the boar's head. Dorran lets regulars use the spit if they mind the floor.

npcs.name: Campfire
npcs.note: The quarrymen's fire, ringed with offcuts of dressed stone. A flat slab by the embers is hot enough to fry on.

npcs.name: Campfire
npcs.note: Oswin's fire never quite goes out. A spit of green wood rests on two forked sticks.

npcs.name: Rune-locked Chest
npcs.note: An old iron-bound chest with a lock of white stone set in its lid, cut like a rune. No pick will turn it; it wants its own key.
npcs.locked: The lock is shaped like an Auren rune. Old Tobb says the Auren threw their keys into Mirror Lake; maybe the lake still has this one.
npcs.found: the Archive's last treasury: Auren silver, a rune core and two flasks of a healer's draught, sealed in wax.

npcs.name: Old Chest
npcs.note: A scribe's chest under the reading desk, its leather gone hard as wood.
npcs.found: a purse of old coin and two cold blue embers in a jar.
